title: Data Visualization with Power Bi
overview: This course will discuss the various methods and best practices that are in line with business and technical requirements for modeling, visualizing, and analyzing data with Power BI . The course will also show how to access and process data from a range of data sources including both relational and non-relational data. It will also explore how to implement proper security standards and policies across the Power BI spectrum including datasets and groups. And discuss how to manage and deploy reports and dashboards for sharing and content distribution. Finally, this course will show how to build paginated reports within the Power BI service and publish them to a workspace for inclusion within Power BI
audience: The audience for this course are data and business intelligence professionals who want to learn how to accurately perform data analysis using Power BI. This course is also targeted toward those individuals who develop reports that visualize data from the data platform technologies that exist on both in the cloud and on-premises.
methodology: We employ research-based training programs with practical Training Methodology and easy-to-understand approach that guarantees the delivery of extensive knowledge implementation over a short period of time
competencies: Model data for performance and scalability
Design and create reports for data analysis
Apply and perform advanced report analytics
Create paginated reports in Power BI
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the role of data analytics within Microsoft's ecosystem and how Power BI fits into it.
Learn to connect to various data sources, profile data, and handle errors within Power BI.
Gain the ability to shape, transform, and optimize data structures for performance in Power BI Desktop.

Acquire skills in designing and optimizing data models, creating calculated columns, measures, and tables using DAX Develop proficiency in creating interactive & visually compelling reports & dashboards that provide actionable insights.
Learn advanced data analytics techniques, including the use of AI visuals to uncover patterns and trends.
Understand how to manage, share, and distribute Power BI content efficiently across workspaces.
Master the application of row-level security to protect data in Power BI reports and dashboards.
Explore the creation & management of datasets, parameters, and the integration of Power BI with other Microsoft services.
